statement: For every d>=1 and cyclic degree n=3 or9 in B_d=L_d(zeta9), all six Hilbert characters of the complete S-unit group have the full product-one image, so the field-norm index is n^5. Actual ideal norm identifies the upper S-class coinvariants with the base S-class group. Complete first-level S-unit/divisor lattices, ordinary-unit corrections and a compatible prime73 generator are evaluated. The exact S-unit norm defect is the invariant upper S-class quotient by extension and has order equal to the actual capitulation kernel.
where_proved: sections/E_sclass_norms.tex, E79.1--E79.24 and full proof; code/e_sclass_norms.py, its seven exact GP dependency/owned stages, complete integral Smith maps and retained source/output.

notes: Every cubic and cyclic ninth-degree field-norm index is proved uniformly by the exact local norm/inclusion square and N(beta_d)=beta_1. The actual S-unit norm subgroup is computed by the explicit obstruction map, not identified with the larger field-norm subgroup. Higher class-module annihilators, capitulation maps and the original eventual exponent h remain unevaluated. At d=1 the norm defect has order dividing3, so every field-norm S-unit has its cube in the actual S-unit norm group. Root full-proof audit PASS; fresh complete author rebuild PASS. The two original L2 BNF sessions remain running without duplication. Root independently rebuilt all seven stages and every Python check; all18 structured records and complete summary JSON agree with no exclusions. The archive driver retains the regenerated BIN, whose complete PARI object equals the author BIN. Subsequent E.86 decision: E.86 evaluates both entire S-class towers in actual coherent prime bases: Cl_S(B_d){3}=C3 and Cl_S(L_d){3}=C3^2, with all adjacent norm matrices identity and all extension matrices zero. The B2 and L2 ordinary three-class groups are C9+C3^2 and C9+C3, with full genus restriction, inverse Smith, ordinary norm and extension maps. All27 E81 ideals are principal and the full B2 principal S-divisor lattice has index27. The cyclic cubic/ninth B-unit defects are C3, with full norm quotient C_(3^r)^5+C3; the adjacent original L-unit defect is C3^2, with full norm quotient C3^3. Explicit Hilbert90 maps and every finite completed norm fibre are proved. Higher ordinary prime3 orders and eventual exponent h, the particular xi*c1 norm coset, and the remaining global and intrinsic section questions stay active.
